notes.title: Major Update! Demo v0.3 Released and Launched for June Next Fest!
notes.notes:
From February to June, we've updated many features, including gameplay for Chapter 2 and Chapter 3! More artistic polish! Better BGM!
This v0.3 update is part of June Next Fest! The content for Chapter 2 and Chapter 3 will be unveiled in the full release.
The update will overwrite v0.2 but won’t affect replayability!
New in this demo:
1.Rearranged levels/tutorials
2.Enhanced visuals
3.New BGM tracks
4.Full controller support
5.Japanese language support

notes.title: Major Update! Demo Version 0.2 Released
notes.notes:
In preparation for the GDWC competition, we've been working hard and have released new demo content in December!
Compared to demo version 0.1, it's almost a complete overhaul, and we welcome players who have tried the demo before to give it another go!
Updates include:
1.Redesigned core mechanics
2.Added new mechanics for Noth
3.Significant increase in maze interaction mechanics
4.Puzzles have been redesigned 
PS: The updated version 0.2 will directly overwrite version 0.1.
